milestone: Engineering implementation of reviewed external evaluation and explicit human qualification records; operational release requires a complete reviewed non-synthetic reference trace.

cases.expected: Exact imported residual reconstruction gives 120 absolute reduction and 3/25 relative reduction; its point estimate meets an at-least one-tenth criterion, with uncertainty limits preserved.
A supported exact 1/20 relative reduction does not meet the registered target. Below-target completion is retained without relabelling the criterion.
Unknown supplied damage remains a precise gap, independently reviewed and persisted; no causal or uncertainty inputs are invented.
Bound/probability criteria unsupported by the registered source method remain gaps; point estimates cannot be substituted.
Another programme's action, incompatible physical scope, protocol/design or source-method version cannot establish this programme's achieved effect.
Material deviations must be accounted for by the external design and review. Missing coverage blocks an unconditional claim.
An independent registered assignment reconstructs exact arithmetic and product bindings; self-review, forged output flags and imported qualification labels cannot grant qualification.
Synthetic physical sources, supplied wrappers, simulated delivery and synthetic review/dossier proofs cannot become an actual programme-effect claim.
Human attestation records adoption, conditional qualification, withdrawal and exact reviewed versions separately; arithmetic agreement never grants scientific qualification.
Unknown/late outcome timing and post-outcome target changes cannot pass a prespecified-target gate; new arithmetic or review does not reset retained outcome access.
Held, revoked, stale or superseded sources, required reviews and withdrawn/conditional qualification withhold the current conclusion while retaining historical originals.

Explicit registration, one active phase, three attempts per phase, twelve total runs and four-hundred-call ceilings apply; generic task admission/update/continue cannot adopt unbound products or bypass programme budgets.

Duplicate operations preserve exact receipts, optimistic revisions and atomic rollback; a fresh process reopens the complete assessment/planning/pilot/registration/delivery/evaluation/review/qualification/learning lineage.
